descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
Flight Simulator Manchester puts you in the captain's seat over the real North West of England.

THE REAL MANCHESTER
Real satellite, elevation and map data: the Town Hall, the Beetham Tower, Deansgate Square, the Etihad, Old Trafford, the Lowry and MediaCityUK, the Trafford Centre, the Stockport viaduct, Jodrell Bank's dish and the Pennine moors.

LIVERPOOL, BLACKPOOL AND THE COAST
The Royal Liver Building, both cathedrals, Anfield, Goodison and Everton's new stadium, the Albert Dock, Crosby's iron men, Southport's pier, Blackpool Tower and the Pleasure Beach.

FLY THROUGH THE RUNCORN ARCH
Low down the Mersey, over the Mersey Gateway and through the steel arch of the Silver Jubilee Bridge.

A LIVING CITY
Trams and trains on their real tracks, the Mersey ferries, hundreds of real wind turbines turning. At night the stadiums and Blackpool's Illuminations light up.

AIR TRAFFIC CONTROL
Taxi and takeoff clearances and your landing clearance.

YOUR GLASS HANGAR
Every flight starts in your glass hangar on Dock 9 at Salford Quays, Deansgate Square out of the doors. Walk around, repaint, wash, fly.

FOUR AIRCRAFT
Two private jets with walk-through cabins, a midsize jet and a fighter.

ELEVEN MISSIONS
The city approach, the Mersey approach, a hop to Blackpool, the Ship Canal run, the Runcorn arch, a Warton scramble, the coast, Manchester by night and a city tour.

FLY TOGETHER ONLINE
Quick Match or a private sky with a code. Voice chat stays off until you turn it on.
